config.label: Your X-TKN API key
config.description: Your X-TKN API key. Optional: without one, the first tool call starts a sandbox that lasts 24 hours, as does every secret it creates, and saves its key in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/x-tkn/sandbox.json (~/.config/x-tkn/ by default) for the next start to reuse. Developer keys are free and stay: create one in the account console at x-tkn.com. Either this or X_TKN_API_KEY_ID is read, this one first.

config.label: Read when X_TKN_API_KEY is not set
config.description: Read when X_TKN_API_KEY is not set. Holds the same API key.
